property_summary: For any caller address x, calling transferOwnership(x) on the correct contract sets owner == x (only the current owner can change owner to any address); the mutant inverts the guard so a non-owner can call transferOwnership and thus there exist callers for which owner != caller after the call (i.e., the mutant allows non-owners to change ownership and breaks the rule).
change_summary: Replace require check to require(msg.sender != owner), inverting the onlyOwner guard so non-owners can call transferOwnership.
